title: Chapter 1306
text:
Rumble!

Explosions occurred one after another. Pillars of fire shot out from the inside of the base, penetrating the armor and creating holes in the base. The location of the explosions kept changing, and the battlefield was moving rapidly.

In the base, the vanguard of the Guild of Gods was already engaged in a fierce battle with Dafis. More guild players were still landing from the airdrop and joining the battle.

Swoosh!

The enormous axe left the handle and spun at a high speed like a saw with blue Mechanical Force arcs around it. Wherever it passed, blood and flesh splattered everywhere, and broken mechanical parts danced in the air. A silver transmission retractable cable was connected to the axe blade and the handle. It twisted and danced like a mad dragon, constantly emitting a 'chi chi' sound as the retractable cable slid. It seemed to be disorderly, but in fact, it strictly controlled the flight path of the axe blade. It was both offensive and defensive.

Mechanical Pugilists were masters at using technological weapons. They researched specific techniques based on the performance and function of a weapon. This was their unique 'Pugilist School'. Therefore, Mechanical Pugilists of the same school would basically use the same mechanical weapons. The axe technique that Dafis used was called 'RC-03 Whip Axe Technique'. The essence of all the techniques was controlling the power of the transmission cable and the transmission shaft. It was good at fighting in complex environments, which was one of the schools that he was proficient in.

Kacha!

The spinning axe cut through the players along the way and stabbed into the chest of an extreme mutant transformed by a player. It was still spinning, cutting through large pieces of bone and flesh.

"I've got him!"

This player adjusted his pain threshold to the lowest, so it was not painful or itchy at all. He grabbed the axe with both hands and did not care about his hands being cut and bleeding.

The extreme mutants of the main tanks all pounced forward. Each of them grabbed a section of the cable and pulled with all their strength to control it. Meanwhile, the teammates of the damage output team all fired at Dafis.

Dafis twisted his hips, and a yellow energy shield flew out and protected him. The attacks of the players all landed on it. In a series of colorful explosions, the shield was quickly filled with cracks.

Taking advantage of the brief moment, Dafis issued an order in his brain, and his neuron signals entered the axe's control module through the transmission line. In that instant, the cable tightened with a bang, and a plasma current flowed along the cable, bouncing away the hands of the many Ultimate Aberrations.

Then, the transmission device instantly overloaded, and with a bang, the speed of the axe soared, cutting off the hands of the player at the end. As the cable retracted, it cut all the aberrations along the way in half, and finally returned to the handle. Then, Dafis spun around, and the axe slashed out a wide silver shockwave surrounded by electric arcs, sending a few Pugilists who wanted to take the opportunity to get close to Euler and beat them up.

Although the players had the numerical advantage, a Calamity Grade Super had a crushing advantage over a Grade B Super. They could only use their lives to exhaust Dafis' status. Before he was completely exhausted, the players would not be able to catch his weakness.

"Continue! Secondary T team, push up!"

"Pay attention to pulling. Damage output team, spread out."

"Outer team, block the small monsters. Don't let them come in and cause trouble!"

The Guild of Gods was forced back time and time again, and their formation was disrupted time and time again. However, they were not afraid of death and continued to surround Dafis after getting up. The captain excitedly gave out orders in the team channel.

To the players, the most unbearable part was that there was no aggro mechanism. In order to control who Dafis attacked, they could only let the MTs block him and use their bodies to form a line of defense.

Even so, Dafis would still choose to go around the MTs and attack the weaker damage output team. Most of the time, they could only improvise and let the squishy players take the damage. Thankfully, the standard armor of the Black Star Corps was very sturdy, so the squishy players would not be killed instantly.

At this time, in the sky above the base, the fleet of the Guild of Gods was already exchanging fire with the fleet of the Heavy Iron Guards.

Due to their numerical disadvantage, the fleet of the Guild of Gods was at a slight disadvantage. However, with their superior performance, as well as their high-tech Virtual Interference and radar jamming, they were able to disrupt the enemy's formation and encroach on the enemy.

The command room kept vibrating. Jupiter pressed his hands on the control panel and stared at the battlefield surveillance footage of Dafis.

He said in a deep voice, "No, the efficiency of the siege is too slow. If this continues, we won't be able to last much longer … Ignore the enemy fleet and aim all weapons at the boss. Support him with firepower!"

"What about the people surrounding him?" Poseidon asked.

"We can't care about the casualties. Tell them to dodge. There's nothing we can do if they get killed," Jupiter said decisively.

"Alright," Jupiter said decisively.

Once the order was given, more than a dozen guild battleships simultaneously shifted their cannons and locked onto Dafis, who was moving around inside the base. A light cannon and a trapezoidal homing missile shot toward him.

Dafis' mechanical suit's built-in radar rang with an ear-piercing warning. He cursed in his mind and hastily dodged. Beams of light pierced through his previous position like spears and chased after him.

Many players had already received the news and dodged early. However, there were always a few who could not dodge in time and were turned into dust.

If the enemy was only a group of Grade B Immortals, it would not be a problem for Dafis. However, with the accurate firepower support of the fleet, he was immediately restricted.

The players were not afraid of being killed, but he was not. A normal Calamity Grade would not be able to withstand too many high-energy ship cannons. Furthermore, he was a Mechanical Pugilist with average defense, so he did not dare take the risk.

Everyone fought fiercely, and the base was in ruins. The Guild of Gods' fleet was pinned down by the enemy ships and could only occasionally break through the defense line to provide support. The shockwaves of the bombardment also gradually injured Dafis.

Seeing another small group of Immortals being killed by the firepower of his teammates while the rest were still yelling and charging, Dafis' eyelids twitched.

"Tsk, these lunatics …"

He could not help but feel like he had poked a hornet's nest. He could not help but feel a little regretful.

Strange, I'm not the only Calamity Grade that the three Universal Civilizations bribed. There are Calamity Grades hunting the players in every area, and I've never heard of anyone being targeted. Why am I so unlucky?

Dafis dodged the five Explosive Fireballs. Looking at the corpses of his subordinates all over the ground, his face became darker and darker.

Although he was not afraid personally, the others in the base were not as strong as him. Grade B Supers were already the backbone of the Heavy Iron Guards, but under the siege of the Guild of Gods, they were almost nothing. A bunch of officers who had followed him for many years were killed.

They were all talents that he had spent a lot of effort to recruit. It was a huge loss!

"This group of Immortals came prepared. If this continues, my strength and stamina will continue to decline. When the time comes, it won't be good. Moreover, they came for me. If I continue to fight here, my casualties will only increase …"

Dafis' eyes were uncertain. After hesitating for a while, he took a deep breath and made the final decision.

The next moment, the energy in his body boiled. He waved his axe, which spun like a top, and threw out a high-frequency shockwave that covered everyone present.

Swoosh!

The blue shockwave exploded with him as the center and spread out rapidly. The strong shockwave knocked over all the surrounding players. Most of them were stunned for a short while.

The players who were immune hurriedly got up and were stunned. They saw that Dafis did not chase after them. Instead, he broke through the wall and ran away, quickly disappearing from everyone's sight.

"He's trying to escape?"

Everyone's expression changed, and they hurriedly chased after him.

However, when they reached the end, they realized that Dafis had already flown into space. His mechanical suit switched to galactic travel mode, and his thrusters shot out flames. His speed kept increasing as he escaped into the distance, his figure becoming smaller and smaller.

"Stop him!"

Jupiter's expression changed. He hurriedly commanded the fleet to break through the Heavy Iron Guards' defense line without caring about the damage they would suffer.

However, at this time, the radars of all the battleships suddenly sounded an alarm.

A small fleet appeared at the edge of the battlefield, rapidly approaching. The Feeney Civilization's logo was on the exterior armor. It shouted in the public channel,

"This is the Feeney Civilization's security patrol team. We've detected an abnormal energy reaction here. Everyone, stop where you are and be inspected!"

"The security team is here too?"

Dafis, who was running away, had a thought.

His base was in the Feeney Civilization's territory. Of course, there were security patrols. They usually minded their own business. He did not know if the security team asked him to stop …

While Dafis was pondering, his mechanical suit suddenly received a communication. It was the Feeney Civilization emissary who came as a guest. The background was the base's safe house.

"Don't stop. Leave this place quickly. The security team won't trouble you." The emissary did not hesitate and went straight to the point.

"You called the security team?" Dafis understood.

"Of course. Why else would I need you to protect me?" The emissary's expression was dark. "I'll get the security team to stop them for a while. Run as far as you can. If they continue to chase after you, I won't care anymore!"

He was only here as a guest. He did not expect to encounter such danger. He was filled with resentment toward Dafis.

Because he was afraid of being killed by the shockwaves, he hurriedly used his authority to call the security team to stop the battle and force Dafis away … In his opinion, since these Immortals were here for revenge, as long as Dafis was far away, the enemies would be lured away too. That way, he would be safe.

"I'll leave now." Dafis nodded. He originally intended to cooperate with the security team to annihilate the enemies, but now he had no choice but to agree to run. He did not want the emissary to be harmed either.

The emissary hesitated for a while before saying with a deep voice, "Planet Burger is nearby. It's a colonial planet where low-value citizens live. I've already talked to the planet manager. You can go to Planet Burger and wait there. Although there aren't many defense forces there, those enemies won't dare violate the peace treaty and attack a colonial planet."

"Okay."

Dafis hung up and accelerated at full speed. Although the guild battleship had placed a space stabilizing anchor that limited hyperdrive, his normal flying speed was not slow either. He turned into a stream of light and quickly disappeared from sight.

Seeing this, Jupiter immediately became anxious.

They had only fought a small part of it, and the boss had already run away. What should they do now?

Poseidon slapped his forehead and complained, "Aiya, I've miscalculated. I knew your plan was unreliable. If they can't beat us, won't they run away? Do you think we're in a dungeon?"

Although they could weaken a Calamity Grade with their lives and even have a chance to kill it, if a Calamity Grade wanted to run away, it would be very difficult for them to stop it. After all, the desperate situation that Atimo was in was very difficult to replicate. Furthermore, Dafis was not an ignorant native. He would run away immediately if he saw that the situation was bad. He would not stand there and fight a bunch of Immortals head-on.

"Shut up!" Veins popped up on Jupiter's forehead as he cursed. He then turned on the public channel and yelled at the security team, "The Black Star Corps is doing something. Please give us some face!"

"I don't care who you are. This is the Feeney Civilization's territory. No one can do whatever they want! Stop the ship immediately for inspection. Otherwise, it'll be considered a violation of the Feeney Civilization Law. Your record will be recorded! "

The security captain received the emissary's order and continued to command the troops to stop the guild fleet.

"Then why didn't you stop the one that ran away?" Jupiter was furious. He marked Dafis, who was getting further and further away.

"What does it have to do with you? I'm giving you an ultimatum right now. Stop the ship immediately!" the security captain yelled.

Jupiter clenched his teeth. After spending so many resources, it would be a huge loss for the guild if they gave up halfway. He was the one who planned this operation, so he had to take the blame. He immediately made up his mind.

"No matter what, we have to kill the boss today! Charge! Cripple anyone who dares to stop us! "

As soon as he said that, the guild fleet did not hesitate anymore. They did not care whether it was the Heavy Iron Guards or the Feeney Civilization Law Enforcement Team in front of them. They fired at all the enemies, trying to kill their way out.

Some of the players who were still in the base were pulled back through the tractor beam, and some of them simply bombarded the area and killed themselves after using up all their energy, reviving back to the ship.

After fighting for a while, most of the players returned to the ship. Only a few people were left in the base. The Army Commander's Big PP was one of them.

"F * ck, you ran away. Don't even think about your hometown anymore!"

Failing to stop Dafis, the Army Commander's Big PP was enraged. He took out a black, ball-shaped portable bomb.

This was a small Dark Energy Annihilation Bomb that he had spent a lot of his savings to buy. Before the Guild of Gods contacted him, he had planned to use this thing to 'die together' with Dafis. Now, he just detonated it.

In the next moment, a dark red lava flow erupted!

Boom!

The ball of light expanded rapidly and swallowed the entire base. Every inch of metal was annihilated.

The emissary who was waiting for the law enforcement team in the safe house did not even have time to react before he was turned into dust by the explosion of dark energy. He died on the spot without any pain.

Not only him, but all the members of the Heavy Iron Guards in the base were also turned into dust. No one survived.

The captain of the security forces was shocked.

"Are these people crazy? How dare they use such a dangerous weapon in a civilized area! "

The Dark Energy Annihilation Bomb was the same as the Psionic Bomb. It was also a dangerous weapon banned by most civilizations. Once discovered, it would be severely punished.

Even some wanted criminals did not dare to do this. Isn't the Black Star Corps from the Lawful Faction? Why are they so reckless? Aren't they afraid of losing their reputation?

For a moment, the security captain was terrified. Since the emissary was already dead, he told the fleet to make way for them, afraid that these lunatics would also use a Dark Energy Annihilation Bomb on him.

Without the obstruction of the security team, the guild fleet broke through the encirclement, shook off the enemies, and chased after Dafis.

The battleship was designed for interstellar travel, so it was even faster than Dafis. The distance between the two gradually decreased.

Dafis also noticed the pursuers behind him. Frustrated, he cursed the security team for not even being able to delay him. He had no choice but to continue running.

After leaving the Space Stabilization Anchor zone, both parties entered hyperdrive mode at the same time. They were like two streams of light, one thick and one thin, one chasing and one escaping.

Not long after, a planet appeared in their vision. It was the low-level colonial planet of the Feeney Civilization, Planet Burger.

The residents on this kind of colonial planet were all leeches who did not want to work. They only accepted welfare to maintain their lives. Every civilization had a planet like this, so they would not be valued. Usually, no outsiders would visit them.

"We're here!" Dafis was overjoyed. He hurriedly sent a landing request.

Because the emissary had already informed them, Planet Burger was a special case and approved his request instantly. The planetary defense fleet outside the atmosphere did not stop him. Seeing this, Dafis broke through the atmosphere without hesitation and landed in one of the cities.

At this time, the Guild of Gods' fleet finally caught up and stopped outside the planet. The small defense team of the planet gathered and stopped them from moving forward.

Their spaceship suddenly received a message. Another artificial appeared on the screen. It was the manager of Planet Burger. His attitude was very cold.

"I'm the manager of Planet Burger. You're not welcome on this planet. Please leave immediately, or I'll call the nearest garrison to expel you."

Hearing this, the guild backbones in the flagship looked at each other, not knowing what to do.

"President, what do we do now? This colonial planet clearly wants to protect our target." Poseidon looked at Jupiter, whose eyes were bloodshot, and carefully said, "How about we retreat? According to the laws of the galactic society, we can't attack a colonial planet …"

Jupiter had a conflicted expression. In the end, he clenched his teeth and squeezed out a voice.

"Who cares who they are? No matter what, we have to kill the target today! Don't let him escape this time. Beat him! "

On the other side, Dafis landed in the city. Only a few pedestrians were on the deserted streets, looking at him in shock.

Dafis did not care about the pedestrians. He looked up at the fleet hovering outside the atmosphere, frustration and anger flashing in his eyes.

He had suffered a huge loss this time, and a lot of his officers had died. His heart was bleeding.

If not for his concerns, he would have killed all these Immortals. He did not want to accept the protection of the planet.

Forget it, a wise man knows better than to fight when the odds are against him. I'll let these people go today, and I'll deal with them one by one in the future. I'll deal with the Black Star Corps slowly …

Dafis clenched his teeth, took out the communicator, and contacted the emissary. He had run very fast back then, so he did not know that his base had been blown up.

He dialed the number, but there was no reply.

Just as Dafis was confused, he suddenly felt a sense of danger and hurriedly retreated!

Rumble!

The next moment, dense light cannons rained down from the sky like a storm, shattering the entire street!

"What!"

Dafis' expression changed drastically. He looked up at the fleet firing at the city in disbelief.

Just to kill me, they dared to fire at a colonial planet without caring about civilian casualties?

What kind of behavior is this? Don't they know? Even the Beyond Grade A Association, which was currently fighting against the three Universal Civilizations, would not do such a heinous thing!

A chill ran down his spine and into his brain. His anger was instantly frozen.

At this moment, Dafis was only filled with horror.

These people are completely lawless!
